name: ResolutionOfInvestigation
label: Resolution Of Investigation
summary: The answer to a cancellation request or investigation: done, in progress, or refused — with a reason.
whenUsed: Sent in reply to a camt.056 cancellation request or a camt.027 claim of non-receipt. Closes the case, or reports that it is still open. Where a recall succeeded, the funds follow separately as a pacs.004.
gotchas: A confirmation status of CNCL means the payment was recalled; ACVA means only that the request was accepted as valid and is being looked at. Reporting ACVA to a customer as 'your money is coming back' is the most common misreading of this message.
This message carries no money. Even a CNCL resolution must be matched to an actual pacs.004 credit before anything is released or re-paid.
RJCR with no explanation is common and unhelpful. Where you are the one refusing, populate the rejection reason — the requesting agent otherwise has to open a fresh case to ask why.

fields.name: Assignment
fields.note: Note the reversal: the assigner here is the agent that received the original request.

fields.name: Resolved Case
fields.note: The case being answered. Must echo the camt.056's Case.Id — this is how the two halves of the exchange are tied together.

fields.name: Status
fields.note: The verdict. A choice between a confirmation and a rejection.

fields.name: Confirmation
fields.note: CNCL for recalled, PDCR for in progress, RJCR for refused, ACVA for accepted and under investigation.

fields.name: Rejected Modification
fields.note: Which requested modifications were refused, where the case was a modification rather than a cancellation.

fields.name: Duplicate Of
fields.note: Points at an earlier identical case — the polite way of saying you have already asked.

fields.name: Cancellation Details
fields.note: Per-transaction outcomes, where one request covered several payments.

fields.name: Transaction Cancellation Status
fields.note: The outcome for this specific payment. Read this rather than the message-level status when several payments were covered.

fields.name: Cancellation Status Reason Information
fields.note: Why a cancellation was refused — typically that the funds were already credited and the beneficiary will not consent.

fields.name: Additional Information
fields.note: Where the real explanation lives. Populate it.

fields.name: Resolution Related Information
fields.note: Compensation, interest and charge-sharing arising from the resolution.

sample: <AddtlInf>Payment stopped before credit, funds returned by pacs.004 RTN-0042</AddtlInf>
